meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw可以用OpenCode作为代理后端，通过OpenRouter、DeepSeek等供应商调用模型，而不只使用Claude。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或配置OpenCode提供商，或把某个组的provider设为opencode时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw can use OpenCode as the agent backend, calling models from providers like OpenRouter and DeepSeek instead of only Claude.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install/configure the OpenCode provider, or set a group's provider to opencode via ncl groups config update.

say_en.text: Add OpenCode as the agent provider.
say_en.note: Starts copying files and rebuilding the image.

say_en.text: Set the provider for a group to opencode.
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update and restarts.
Sets OPENCODE_PROVIDER and related env vars.
